MH Type Oil Gage

The MH type oil gage has a special reinforced resin body with excellent clarity and pressure resistance, and also offers chemical resistance; however, it is not universally resistant to all chemicals, so please use caution.

MHS Type Oil Gage

The MHS type OIL-GAUGE solves the problems of breakage and oil leakage, has high pressure resistance, and poses no issues even under high heat. After machining the threaded hole according to the dimension table, simply screw it in all the way since it has an O-ring, and there is no risk of oil leakage even without tightening it with great force.
